outcome: Concentrations of amniotic fluid pro-inflammatory cytokines
Membrane expression of inflammasome sensors (NLRP3, NLRC4, AIM2, NOD2)
cohort: Eight chronically catheterized pregnant rhesus macaques (four received U. parvum, four received sterile media as controls).
finding: Choriodecidual Ureaplasma infection in rhesus macaques activated inflammasome complexes and associated pathways in fetal membranes, increasing the expression of MMP-9, PTGS2, inflammasome sensors, IL-1b, IL-18, CASPASE-1, MYD88, and NFkB, without causing preterm labor or detectable intra-amniotic infection.
gest_age: ~105-112 days at surgery, ~115-119 days at inoculation, and 136-140 days at C-section (term=167 days)
